integration.consumers: consume the contract and the provided ports through host adapters; never read the identity schema
integration.composition: host supplies ports from a Nitro plugin; persistence follows ADR-0002; Identity holds no personal data (ADR-0005)
integration.standalone: A host may compose Identity with its PostgreSQL pool alone; missing caller, access, approval and event-delivery providers are refusal-only. This is not a functional IAM deployment.
integration.operational: Authentication and Authorisation remain required capabilities for full operational IAM composition; a verified caller, access decisions, approval qualification and successful event delivery must be provided before protected operations can function.
integration.portSemantics: Port optionality describes the composeIdentity startup parameter, not whether a working provider is required to perform the corresponding protected operation.
